about: Labelled retrieval queries for the Roblox documentation corpus. Positives name the page a correct answer must surface; negatives are questions the corpus genuinely cannot answer, and a retriever is right to return nothing for them ONLY if it can also confirm it searched something. Every expectUrl below is asserted to exist in packages/corpus/data/chunks.jsonl by apps/worker/tests/retrieval-gold.test.mjs — a gold set whose answers are not in the corpus measures nothing.

queries.query: how do I change how fast a player character walks
smoothly animate a part from one position to another over time
automatically remove an instance after a few seconds
tag instances and find every instance with a given tag
send a message from the server to a client without waiting for a reply
detect when the player presses a key on the keyboard
show a hold E to interact prompt on an object
save player data so it persists between sessions
run code every frame and tell whether the code is running on the server
attach two parts together so they move as one rigid object
change the time of day and the ambient colour of the world
make a clickable button in the player interface with text on it
configure a PostgreSQL connection pool with pgbouncer
SwiftUI NavigationStack deep linking on iPadOS
kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaler custom metrics adapter
